title: Offline consumer evidence and repeat package
summary: Run local evidence jobs (release brief, table reconcile, procurement brief, and related checks) on files you supply. Verify size and sha256 before extract. The CLI does not fetch, charge, or overwrite caller files.
coldStart: python3 -c "import hashlib,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('s178-consumer-repeat-kit.tgz'); b=p.read_bytes(); assert len(b)==718948, len(b); h=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(); assert h=='04e9b6f382eedd91ae27b0d0faa68abbee7c26a1f06f52e415cb5a5884dfe05d', h"
materialLimit: You must supply an operator clock. Local provenance files are integrity metadata, not an independent attestation, and ok:true is honest completion rather than a pass.
note: Exact committed merchant archive bytes. Local CONSUMER-PROVENANCE.json is integrity metadata, not an independent attestation. ok:true is honest completion, not a pass claim.
